task is taken by a free worker
The active Run Target did not change,
kAborting while other jobs are running,
[no recovery action || kGlobal recovery action || other Graph State]
kAborting while jobs are running, kUndefinedState otherwise.
always switch to the fallback Run Target.
In kUndefinedState the main loop starts the pending Run Target, or the fallback Run Target otherwise.
A request for a different Run Target, or a shutdown, while in kComponentRecovery cancels the
ongoing recoveries: the Graph moves to kAborting and stops their stop token.
A request for the active Run Target is answered with kAlreadyInState and does not interrupt the recovery.
